script:
---
title: Three for three
season: 2027
week: 4
date: 2026-11-09
segment: 7:20
lapel: poppy
---

# Cold open: tight on Don. The sincere stretch: the Memorial Cup (CHL history of Capt. James T. Sutherland). No bits, no yells.
[don: remembrance-rest, ron: rest, cam: close don]
>> off

DON (remembrance-point): Ron. Every spring, best junior teams in the country. What do they compete for?

RON (warm): The Memorial Cup.

DON (remembrance-rest, warm): The Memorial Cup. [beat] You ever think about who it's for?

[cam: wide]
DON (remembrance-rest, warm): [>> title "The Memorial Cup" "First awarded 1919"] Fella named Sutherland.
  Coached the junior team in Kingston. Won the Ontario league, 1910-1911.
  Then the war came, and he signed up himself.

RON (warm): [>> list "Kingston, 1910–11" "Scotty Davidson" "Killed in action", "George Richardson" "Killed in action"] 2 of his players didn't come home.

DON (remembrance-rest, warm, slow): So he made a cup. [beat] For every Canadian that didn't.
  {warm: And that's who it's for. Every one we've lost.}

DON (remembrance-lean, warm): So when some kid lifts it this spring, [beat] {warm slow: that's who he's lifting.}

[don: remembrance-rest, ron: rest, 1.4s]

# The record: Ron gives it the fanfare; Don scoffs that it just fell 3 weeks ago and predicts more, which tips him into the scoring rant.
RON: [>> stat "311" "All-time record" "Most points in one week" JAGR] 311. The most points in a week in league history.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.0s] Don reads the number. Unimpressed.

DON (remembrance-rest, deadpan): Again?

RON: Varrock set the old record opening week.

DON (remembrance-point): 3 weeks ago! [beat] Before that, nobody touched it for 7 years.

DON (remembrance-lean, firm): Nick. [beat] Don't frame it.
  {firm: The way you're going, you'll break it 3, 4 more times this year yourself.}

RON: [>> numbers JAGR 20 goals, 5 game-winners, 35 hits "Week 4"] 20 goals in a week.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!20 GOALS!!! [remembrance-point] Where was the other team?

# Scoring: Don's grievance is the long trend, not this season. NHL goals per game from the NHL stats API.
RON: [>> list "NHL goals per game" "2015–16" 5.3, "2020–21" 5.8, "This season" 6.3] It's not just us. NHL scoring's the highest in over 30 years.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!30 YEARS!!!

DON (remembrance-point, firm): That's what I'm saying! Every year, more goals. Nobody's checking anybody. Nobody comes back.

DON (remembrance-lean, firm): When I coached Boston, you gave up 4, you didn't eat.
  We had Bobby. Best there ever was. {firm: Nobody got by him.}

RON (deadpan): Well even he scored 46 goals--

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!HE COULD DO BOTH!!!

[don: remembrance-tie, ron: down, 1.1s] Adjusts tie. Looks at the desk.

DON (remembrance-rest, deadpan, slow): What was I saying?

RON (deadpan): Nobody backchecks.

DON (remembrance-point, firm): Nobody backchecks!

# Ron reveals where Jagrtown did it. Ron took Jagrtown first; Don got Hamhung and still hasn't forgiven it.
RON: [>> matchup HUNG 246.95 JAGR 311.15 final "Last week's featured matchup"] And Jagrtown's 311 came in our featured matchup.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.1s] It dawns on Don.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!THAT WAS MY PICK!!!

RON (deadpan): You had the Hall Monitors.

DON (remembrance-point): I had Jagrtown! I said it first. {mock: "Just don't take--"}

RON (deadpan): You didn't finish.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!EVERYBODY KNEW HOW IT ENDED!!!

[ron: down, 600ms] Ron looks down.

RON: [>> list "Featured matchup picks" "Don" "2/3 · 67%", "Ron" "1/3 · 33%"] So. Don's 2 for 3. I'm 1 for--

DON (remembrance-point, firm): No. [beat] We both wanted Jagrtown. We both get the point.
  [>> list "Featured matchup picks" "Don" "3/3 · 100%", "Ron" "1/3 · 33%"] There. 3 for 3.

[ron: surprised, 800ms] Ron turns to the monitor.

RON (skeptical): Who changed the monitor?

DON (remembrance-thumbs, then remembrance-stare): It's fixed.

RON (firm): You picked Hamhung.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!YOU STOLE MY TEAM!!! [remembrance-point] From now on, I like a team, I get the team. I don't care who goes first.

RON: And if we both like the same team?

DON (remembrance-point): Then we both get it!

RON (deadpan): Fine.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, then remembrance-stare): Fine.

# Gauthier: Don praises the scorer he should be blaming, then narrows the claim.
RON: [>> stat "11" "Nov. goals" "Cutter Gauthier / 3 hat tricks in 5 games" JAGR with "Cutter Gauthier"] Now, the hottest scorer in hockey. Cutter Gauthier. 11 goals in November.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, warm): [fx: don happy 3s] 11! In 8 days! Now that's a hockey player. Goes to the net. Shoots the thing.

RON (skeptical): You just said scoring's the problem.

DON (remembrance-point, firm): He's not the problem! The fellas letting him are the problem.

RON: [>> list "Most goals in a month" "Teemu Selänne" "20 · Mar. 1993", "Joe Malone" "20 · Feb. 1921", "Cutter Gauthier" "11 · Nov. 1–8"] The NHL record for goals in a month is 20.

DON (remembrance-surprised): 20! Who's got that?

RON: Teemu Selanne and Joe Malone. Anaheim has 10 games left this month.

DON (remembrance-thumbs): 10 games. [beat] He'll get there.

RON: Jagrtown got him off the wire 8 days--

DON (remembrance-point): Off the wire! And he sat there a week before that! Everybody in this league walked right past him.
  {firm: Best pickup of the year. Not close.}

# McDavid: one exchange. He's the exception, then the exceptions pile up. 84-game season: 47 points in 18 games paces 219.
RON: [>> numbers VWIZ 8 points, 3 games with "Connor McDavid" "Nov. 2–8"] McDavid. On pace for 219.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, warm): McDavid. [beat] He's allowed.

RON (deadpan): So scoring's fine for McDavid.

DON (remembrance-point): And Gauthier. [beat] !!AND THAT'S IT!!!

# Montreal: the defence sermon gets its proof. League ties: New Purrsey's Fowler.
RON: [>> stat "4–0" "Montreal over Winnipeg" "Tue. Nov. 3 · 2:39 left"] Tuesday. Montreal's up 4-0 on Winnipeg.

DON (remembrance-thumbs): Good. Game's over. Shake hands.

RON: Winnipeg scored 4 in 2 minutes. Won in overtime.

DON (remembrance-surprised): [fx: don shocked 800ms] 4?

RON: [>> list "Down 4+, 3 min. left" "Won" 1, "Lost" "10 300", "Tied" 0] Never happened before.

DON (remembrance-surprised, slow): 1 and 10,300.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!10,000 TEAMS PLAYED DEFENCE FOR 3 MINUTES!!! [remembrance-point] And Montreal couldn't!

RON: New Purrsey's Jacob Fowler stopped the first 37.

DON (remembrance-point, firm): 37! The kid stands on his head. [beat] {warm remembrance-thumbs: That's a young Carey Price.}
  [remembrance-point] And they leave him out there alone!

RON: And in Winnipeg's net, Stuart Skinner.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, warm): Skinner! Swift Current Broncos. Took 'em to a Memorial Cup.

RON: The Hall Monitors dropped him Saturday.

# Waiver Wire Watch replaces Wilson Watch. Fantrax claims and drops, Nov. 2–9. No Varrock or Lalibirdies corrections.
RON: [>> title "Waiver Wire Watch" "Week 4"] Which brings us to Waiver Wire Watch.

DON (remembrance-surprised): Where's Wilson Watch?

RON (deadpan): Retired.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.2s] Don stares at Ron.

DON (remembrance-rest, deadpan, slow): He's still due.

[ron: down, 600ms] Ron looks down.

RON: [>> wire drop HUNG "Stuart Skinner" fpts 71.9 fpg 5.53 "Won both starts, dropped Sat. / Won again Sunday"] Skinner.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.0s] Don reads the card.

DON (remembrance-point): Won both starts. Dropped. [beat] And he won again Sunday? {firm: He won you both games, Andrew!}

RON: Devon Levi came off injured reserve Saturday and--

DON (remembrance-point, firm): Then drop him Monday!

RON: Levi's averaging 6.82 fantasy points a game. Skinner, 5.53.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.0s] Don does the math. Loses.

DON (remembrance-rest, deadpan): Who's got Skinner now?

RON (deadpan): Nobody. That's the segment.

DON (remembrance-point, firm): I know that. [beat] Somebody take him.

RON: [>> wire claim JAGR "Ryan O'Reilly" fpts 96.5 fpg 5.68 "Mon. Nov. 9 · C, Nashville"] Jagrtown picked up Ryan O'Reilly this morning.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, warm): O'Reilly! [remembrance-point] Now there's a fella who comes back. Plays both ends.
  {firm: Somebody over there has to backcheck!}

RON: [>> wire claim PVLS "Charle-Edouard D'Astous" fpts 79 fpg 4.94 "Sun. Nov. 8 · D, Tampa Bay"] Paddyville grabbed Charle-Edouard D'Astous. Never drafted.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, warm): [fx: don happy 3s] Never drafted! Nobody wanted him, and he made it anyway.
  {firm remembrance-point: And Paddyville went and got a defenceman. Finally. Somebody.}

RON: [>> wire swap HH "Mackenzie Blackwood" "John Gibson" fpg 6.46 fpts 90.4 fpg 3.69 fpts 40.6 "Sun. Nov. 8"] Hooterville changed goalies. Blackwood in, Gibson out.

DON (remembrance-point): Blackwood.

RON: Shut out Detroit Saturday.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!A SHUTOUT! SOMEBODY STOPPED A PUCK!!!

DON (remembrance-thumbs, deadpan): Jeremy. Smart.

RON: [>> wire free "Kent Johnson" fpts 83.75 fpg 5.58 "Columbus · 5th overall, 2021 / 57 points in 2024–25"] Still out there: Kent Johnson. 5th overall pick. 57 points 2 years ago.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!AND NOBODY'S GOT HIM?!!!

RON: 5.58 fantasy points a game. Better than half the forwards on rosters.

DON (remembrance-lean, firm): Brian. Eric. Kaley. [beat] You're all looking for wins. He's sitting right there.
  {firm: You saw what Jagrtown did with Gauthier.}

# West Texas: speculation only, and labelled as the hosts guessing. Nobody in West Texas has said anything.
RON: Unless somebody isn't looking for wins.

DON (remembrance-surprised): What's that mean?

RON: [>> matchup TEEHAW 119.55 NPD 198.65 final "Week 4 / Final"] West Texas scored 119. Lowest of the year.

DON (remembrance-stare, deadpan, slow): [>> standings "Bottom of the table" Reapers 1 3 755.60, Lali 0 4 709.50, TEEHAW 0 4 584.50] 0-4. 584.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!NOBODY TANKS IN THIS LEAGUE!!!

RON (deadpan): Nobody said tank.

DON (remembrance-point): You had the face.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.3s]

DON (remembrance-rest, warm, slow): Another top pick, though. [beat] Next to McKenney. {warm remembrance-thumbs: Sounds exciting, I'd watch that.}

RON: That's speculation. West Texas hasn't said a word.

DON (remembrance-point): Here's some speculation for you, Matthews goes at the deadline!

RON (warning): Harmless speculation.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, firm): I'm usually right.

[ron: down, 700ms] Ron looks down.

# Hellebuyck: Don's case is simple. He doesn't want to face Winnipeg, and the Devils are covering for him.
RON: [>> stat "5" "Straight wins" "Connor Hellebuyck / New Jersey · Shutout Sunday" VWIZ with "Connor Hellebuyck"] Hellebuyck shut out Toronto last night. Tomorrow, he goes back to Winnipeg.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, firm): Good. Let 'em give it to him.

RON: He's not playing.

DON (remembrance-surprised): [fx: don shocked 500ms] Not playing?

RON: [>> list "Devils GM Sunny Mehta" "Decision" Organizational, "Reason" "Expected win probability", "Hellebuyck" "Wanted to play"] The Devils say it's their call. He wanted to play.

DON (remembrance-lean, firm): Wanted to play. [beat] Come on. He doesn't want to go in there. {firm: And the Devils are covering for him.}

RON: They said it's about expected win probability.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!EXPECTED WIN PROBABILITY!!!

[don: remembrance-pound-ready, 220ms]
[don: remembrance-pound, sfx: desk-pound, 480ms]

DON (remembrance-point, firm): That's a fancy way of saying he's a coward!
  11 years those people cheered for him. Winnipeg! Hockey people!
  You go in there. You take your boos. You tip your cap. {firm: That's what you owe 'em.}

DON (remembrance-lean, firm): Instead he's hiding in the back like a chickensh--

RON (firm, warning): Don.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!CHICKEN!!! [beat] {firm remembrance-point: He's a chicken.}

[ron: down, 700ms] Ron looks down.

# Russia: Don loves the old rivalry, but he's with Canada. His fire goes at the court.
RON: [>> list "Russia's return" "Ordered by" "Court of Arbitration for Sport", "Won't play them" "Six countries", "World Juniors" "Canada: no visas"] A sports court has ordered Russia back into international hockey.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, warm): The Summit Series. [beat] Canada and the Russians. Henderson scores, and the whole country stops.
  {warm: I loved beating the Russians. Best hockey there ever was.}

RON: [>> stat "6" "Won't play Russia" "Finland · Sweden · Norway · Denmark · Latvia · Czechia"] 6 countries say they won't play them.

DON (remembrance-point): Then Canada will! We'll beat 'em for everybody--

RON (firm): Don. There's a war on.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.4s]

RON: World Juniors are in Alberta at Christmas. The Prime Minister says they won't get in.

DON (remembrance-rest, firm, slow): Good. [beat] Canada's right. Not while there's a war on.

DON (remembrance-point): But who let 'em back in? A court! In Switzerland! [beat] {firm: Lawyers.}

RON: The Court of Arbitration for--

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!NOBODY IN THAT ROOM EVER BLOCKED A SHOT IN THEIR LIFE!!!

[ron: down, 700ms] Ron looks down.

# Next week's featured matchup. Don picks first. Under Don's own new rule, Ron takes the same team.
RON: [>> matchup HH PVLS "Week 5 / Featured matchup"] Our featured matchup for the week ahead: Hooterville at Paddyville. Both 3-1. Top 2 get a--

DON (remembrance-point): I pick first.

RON: You pick first.

DON (remembrance-thumbs, firm): Hooterville. They've got a goalie now.

RON: Same.

DON (remembrance-surprised): [fx: don shocked 800ms] What?

RON: Hooterville.

DON (remembrance-angry, yell): !!THAT'S MY TEAM!!!

RON (deadpan): [>> list "Week 5 picks" "Don" Hooterville, "Ron" Hooterville] We both like it. We both get it.

DON (remembrance-point): Who made that rule?

RON (deadpan): You did.

[don: remembrance-stare, ron: rest, 1.5s]

DON (remembrance-rest, deadpan): It's a good rule.

# Out: the scoreboard argument gets the last word.
RON: [>> logo] That's Coach's Corner.

DON (remembrance-point): 3 for 3.

RON (deadpan): 2 for 3.

[1.5s]
